title: phanera kingii
intro: Phanera kingii, commonly known as the "King's Tree" or "White Oak", is a species of flowering plant in the family Moraceae, native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Phanera kingii are attributed to its ability to relax the muscles, improve cardiovascular function, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Phanera kingii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to contribute to its medicinal properties.
